messages.subject: Lunchtime seminar: Building Safety Act 2022 - what real estate teams need to know
messages.plaintextBody:
Join us on 26 March (12:30-13:30, Room 6 / Teams) for a CPD seminar on the latest Building Safety Act developments and their impact on commercial property transactions. Sandwiches provided. Reserve your place via the link in the calendar invite.

Knowledge & Learning
